summary: Executed backend + frontend regression for v13.28-safe-restore using real authenticated APIs, real uploaded audio/videos, and TEST-ONLY fault injection on clip download. Core restore blocking/unblocking and persistence-on-recovery behavior validated; one critical UI confirm-flow check remains unresolved.

ui_bugs.issue: Could not observe expected confirm dialog on missing reference remove (cancel phase) in automated run; flow remains unverified/possibly bypassed in this path.

integration_issues.flow: Safe restore with one clip fetch failure
integration_issues.issue: Initial restore stayed blocked with slot placeholder and no project write while incomplete; after real retry and recovery, save resumed and persisted correctly. Confirm-remove branch failed verification and needs manual/agent retest.

action_items: Investigate/verify missing-reference remove confirm behavior for cancel/accept paths in real UI interaction (automation did not receive dialog event).
Re-run full iter40 frontend script after confirm-flow fix to complete remaining assertions (remove/cancel/accept index update branch).
Optionally add dedicated data-testid/state hook for confirm-open on missing-reference remove to make this branch deterministic under automation.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/tests/backend_test.py currently hardcodes fallback BASE_URL/MONGO defaults; this violates strict env-only fail-fast guideline and can hide misconfiguration during CI.

Restore-safety critical paths in studio.html are tightly coupled in one very large file; high regression risk around async loading/save race paths suggests splitting restore/save modules for maintainability and safer future changes.
seed_data_creation: Created disposable authenticated projects only: QA_DISPOSABLE_ITER40_RESTORE_1 and QA_DISPOSABLE_ITER40_RESTORE_2; both deleted in cleanup. Uploaded temporary test media via real API; no existing user projects/accounts modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: frontend_restore_safe_iter40.json contains completed checks: blocked save on incomplete restore, no POST while blocked, retry recovery unblocks + autosaves, fresh-context reopen exact state, partial retry/unrelated import still blocked. Remaining failed branch: confirm dialog detection on missing remove cancel/accept.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: open project with missing reference (no mediaId/url) and trigger missing-slot remove action from missing card. Expected native confirm event was not observed by Playwright page dialog listener in this run, so cancel/accept branch assertions could not complete. Likely causes: confirm path not firing in this DOM state, or dialog handling differs under iframe/event context. Mitigation: instrument removeClip path with a test-visible state flag or custom modal data-testid and retest cancel/accept semantics.
